Voxel Cone Tracing | OGRE - Open Source 3D Graphics Engine
Anisotropic vs Isotropic VCT supports Anisotropic and Isotropic modes. VCT relies heavily on voxel's mips. The problem with mipmaps is that they are an average in all directions. That means higher mips lose a lot of information. If the left wall is blue and the right wall is red, eventually they get averaged into a dark pink!
